blocks.text: Mind-blowing picture. Head-turning design. Next-level AI. Our best and brightest OLED ever. Introducing the LG OLED evo G5, designed for stunning, personalized performance in any room. Powered by the Alpha 11 AI Processor Gen2, it delivers optimized picture and sound. Brightness Booster Max enhances luminosity for glare-free, high-contrast images—while 8.3 million self-lit pixels deliver perfect black and vibrant color. When not in use, display art or photos to blend into your space. LG webOS 25 with AI Search helps you stream faster, while Quick Cards organize your favorite apps for easy access—including 350+ free channels⁵ with LG Channels. Plus, every LG OLED includes Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos³ for an immersive, cinematic experience. With FILMMAKER MODE, see movies just as the director intended. And with a 5-year panel warranty⁷, you can enjoy peace of mind and exceptional performance that lasts. ¹Source: Omdia. Unit shipments, 2013–2024. Results are not an endorsement of LG Electronics. Consumers who disable “auto-update” will receive a pop-up notification to accept or deny software update. ⁶Google is a trademark of Google LLC. Google Assistant is not available in certain languages and countries. Apple, the Apple logo and HomeKit are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. ⁷In the 1st year of the warranty, panel, parts and labor costs are covered. In the 2nd–5th year, only panels are covered and labor will be charged. The 5-year limited panel warranty is available for the G, M & Z Series. ⁸Subscription and compatible gaming controller are required.

items.label: BRIGHTNESS BOOSTER MAX
items.value: The LG OLED evo shines even brighter than before. Brightness Booster Max technology magnifies each individual pixel for luminous quality that shines with every detail.

items.label: BRIGHT ROOM READY
items.value: Verified by UL for Discomfort Glare Free (UGR less than 22), you can be confident your LG OLED TV performs great no matter the room or the lighting. With LG OLED you still experience perfect black that delivers stunning picture other brands just can't match.

items.label: ALPHA 11 AI PROCESSOR GEN2
items.value: Enjoy personalized, crisp picture and sound no matter what you watch with AI Picture Pro and AI Super Upscaling². Find and choose what to watch fast and without lag. See movies in perfect tone with AI Director Processing.

items.label: PERFECT BLACK AND PERFECT COLOR
items.value: LG's flagship OLED technology creates an incredible watching experience and stellar picture quality with Perfect Black and Perfect Color technology on over 8.3 million self-lit smart pixels, even in bright rooms.

items.label: DOLBY VISION, DOLBY ATMOS, FILMMAKER MODE
items.value: Enjoy movie magic. Loaded with Dolby Vision for extraordinary color, contrast and brightness, plus Dolby Atmos³ for sound you can feel all around you. Land in the center of the action with FILMMAKER MODE, allowing you to see films just as the director intended.

items.label: ULTIMATE GAMING
items.value: Experience crisp, smooth imagery from a 0.1ms response time and up to 120Hz refresh rate to let you game at blinding speed without any blurring or tearing to keep up with the fastest games. All LG OLED TVs have NVIDIA G-Sync, AMD FreeSync Premium and VRR to further improve gaming quality. Four HDMI 2.1 inputs allow you to plug in all the devices you need. Whether you game on consoles or on the cloud⁸, the LG Game Dashboard and Game Optimizer put all the control at your fingertips.

items.label: WEBOS
items.value: LG’s Award winning Smart TV platform powered by webOS. Get access to apps and view over 350 free LG Channels. Plus get up to 5 years of software updates with webOS Re:New⁵.

items.label: ONE WALL DESIGN
items.value: Transform your home into a more artful space with the all-new, contemporary LG OLED design that leaves virtually no gap when you hang it on the wall.⁴ And when you're not watching, display paintings, photos and other content to blend the LG OLED evo G4 into your surroundings.

items.value: AI Picture, OLED Dynamic Tone Mapping Pro, a11 AI Processor 4K Gen2, a9 AI Super Upscaling 4K
